candidates.value: Boot, load, and transfer faster with the XPG SX6000 Pro PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 solid state drive (SSD). With support for NVMe 1.3 and equipped with 3D NAND Flash, it offers up to 4times faster performance than SATA SSDs and up to 1TB of capacity. What’s more, the SX6000 Pro is slimmer than standard M.2 2280 SSDs for a higher level of compatibility thanks to its single-sided design.Ultra-fast PCIe Gen3x4 interface: R/W speed up to 2100/1500MB/sNVMe 1.3 support2ND generation 64-layer 3D NAND FlashAdvanced LDPC ECC (Host Memory Buffer) and SLC Caching

XPG SX6000 Pro PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 solid state drive (SSD) Internal Solid State Drive, NVMe 1.3-support, Featuring HMB (Host Memory Buffer) and SLC Caching, single-sided design that’s 2.15mm thick, the SX6000 Pro is much slimmer than standard M.2 SSDs.
